title: Windgram site catalogue, sites.json

slug.description: Lowercase hyphenated slug — the identity of models and sites everywhere.

timeZone.description: The site's IANA timezone (e.g. "America/Vancouver") — required; the catalogue is its home. Local time is load-bearing for reading a windgram, and builders echo it per-profile as the optional site.timeZone.

items.description: One catalogued site: identity and build selection only — humans author WHERE, and nothing physical. The pipeline measures WHAT at these coordinates and publishes it in site-context.json.

description: sites.json — the hand-maintained site catalogue: every site the builders publish documents for. Identity and build selection only: humans author WHERE; the pipeline measures WHAT (site-context.json). Published to the dataset root verbatim.
